incidents.name: Libertify
incidents.notes: LibertiVault.deposit calls an external swap that reenters deposit to mint excess shares against stale totalSupply.

sources.ref: re-check 2026 (deployment-basis rows with a DELEGATECALL in the runtime): CONFIRMED deployment basis. The vault is an EIP-1167 minimal proxy whose runtime hardcodes the LibertiVault master 0x089d9868b58ef37d5804281e106d9b7e71a4d05f, so the delegate target cannot be repointed; the master's runtime is byte-identical at 13 sample points across [40785922, 44941585] and contains zero DELEGATECALL opcodes, and callTracer on the exploit tx confirms the clone delegatecalls only the master.
